sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. N.C. Das, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Mr. H.M. Dhal, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties.
3.
The petitioners have filed this writ petition claiming for compensation under the Land Acquisition Act.

4. Mr. H.M. Dhal, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties contended that the writ petition is not maintainable, as the petitioners have filed this writ petition jointly, although they have similar nature of grievance but in respect of different patch of land and different area.

5. Considering the contention raised by learned Additional Government Advocate, this Court is of the considered view that since the petitioners, having similar nature of grievance in respect of different patch of land and different area, have filed this writ petition jointly, this Court is not inclined to entertain this writ petition.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioners to file separate representation before opposite party no.3 claiming compensation.
In the event the petitioners file representation within a period of ten days, opposite party no.3 shall consider and dispose of the same in accordance with law.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (M.S. RAMAN) Alok JUDGE Dusmanta Kumar Palei & Ors vs State Of Odisha & Ors.
